description: Kamchatka safety context for a place or route: place status, hazards, active alerts; a catalog route with no place record gets today's go/caution/no call and park permit terms. Facts: get_place_info. Also live KB GS RAS alerts, crowding and local knowledge. The route call (go / caution / not today) has its reason and matches the route card; permit terms are as recorded. With only a similar route name, it is named as an inexact match. Always use it for a specific place, volcano, lake, route or hot spring.
name: get_guardian_context

found.description: Place found in the Vedar directory. false — no status, which does not mean safe; a catalog route with that name, if any, is in routes

places.description: Matched places, up to three. Hazards, volcano codes, routes and alerts are in the text

color.description: Colour, also when closed; null — none

level.description: Status for going out today: closed; red, yellow, green — regional-report colour (green is no safety guarantee); unknown — no colour, not «safe»

match.description: low — inexact match, may be another place: ask the person

outside_sources.description: Outside regional reports (Northern Kurils): never green; «no warnings» cannot be said

reason.description: park_season — yellow: park trails closed off-season, no independent hiking; the operator confirms park approval. null — not recorded

status_updated_at.description: Computed at, ISO 8601 UTC; null — not recorded

routes.description: Catalog routes with that name when no place or only an inexact one matched; otherwise up to three similar names (match: low). Each has today's call as on its card. Empty when a place is found does not mean no routes: they are in the text

alerts.description: Active route warnings; null — could not read (not «no warnings»)

code.description: Reason code: alert_ban — ban in a report; point_closed — a route point closed; volcano_red, volcano_orange — KVERT code on the route; signals_unknown — could not read what may hide a ban; alert_warning — active warning; out_of_season; clear — nothing found

match.description: high — named by the query; low — only similar, may be another route: ask the person

park_name.description: Protected area of the route as recorded; its administration sets visit terms

today.description: Today's call: go — no warnings, dangerous volcano codes or closed points found (not a safety guarantee); caution — a reason for care or too little data; no — do not go today. Not an official bulletin

unknown.description: What could not be read (warnings, volcanoes, closed points); non-empty rules out go

title: Place safety
